tools.name: trdefi_stats
tools.description: Aggregate statistics for the live TRDEFI non-custodial stablecoin liquidity catalogue: how many open maker positions exist, how many distinct makers, how many pairs, across how many networks, plus settled volume over 1, 7 and 30 days, and the deepest pairs by volume and by position count. tools.name: trdefi_chains
tools.description: The networks where liquidity is live right now, with each network's settlement engine address and the tokens a position can be built from. Use this instead of hardcoding chain or token identifiers.

tools.name: trdefi_positions
tools.description: Live non-custodial stablecoin liquidity, as positions an agent can actually trade against. Earn-worthy USDC/USDT maker positions: each row carries the strategy hash, network, pair, tokens and settled volume. tools.name: trdefi_position_detail
tools.description: One position in full, by its 32-byte strategy hash.

tools.description: Price a stablecoin swap against one position, on-chain, at the current block — no custody, nothing signed, nothing moved.
